title: Define the security-sensitive path inventory and create named ExampleCo review teams
description: Create an approval matrix for code review, owned by the CISO. It lists the security-sensitive paths in each repository and the ExampleCo team accountable for each. mongodb-mcp-server (applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server): deploy/, .github/workflows/, .github/CODEOWNERS, src/, Dockerfile. onfinance-db-model-master (applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master): onfinance_db_model_master/, setup.py. Create the matching GitHub teams in the OnFinance organisation, for example @OnFinance/platform-security for CI and deployment paths and @OnFinance/data-model-owners for the shared data-model package. Each team needs at least two members, because sdlc/policy.json codeReview.selfApprovalAllowed is false. Do not use the inherited upstream team @mongodb-js/mcp-server-developers. Record the matrix as evidence on this task. Do not create a file in the Maxwell workspace. Constraint: sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess defines no deploymentWindows and no change freeze applies to organisation settings, but team creation must not remove existing repository collaborators.
acceptanceCriteria: An approval matrix signed off by the CISO exists and is attached as task evidence. It lists every path named in the description with exactly one accountable ExampleCo team and a named escalation contact.
`gh api orgs/OnFinance/teams/<team-slug>/members --jq length` returns 2 or more for every team named in the matrix.
No row of the matrix names @mongodb-js/mcp-server-developers or any team outside the OnFinance organisation.

verificationMethod.description: The compliance officer reviews the attached approval matrix against the path list in this task and runs `gh api orgs/OnFinance/teams/<team-slug>/members --jq length` for each named team. Expected: every path has one ExampleCo owner team, every team has at least 2 members, and the CISO sign-off is present.

rootCause.description: ExampleCo never defined which code paths are security-sensitive or who must review them. The mongodb-mcp-server fork kept the upstream maintainers' team as its only owner, so no ExampleCo role is accountable for CI, deployment or data-model changes.
